content: आशंस् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (rarely <ab>P.</ab>) .²1 To hope for, expect, desire, wish or long for; स्वकार्यासिद्धिं पुनराशशंसे <ls>Ku. 3. 57</ls>; <ls>Bk. 14. 70</ls>, <ls n="Bk. 14.">90</ls>; आशंसन्ते सुरसमितयः <ls>Ś. 2. 16</ls>; <ls>M. 1</ls>; मनोरथाय नाशंसे <ls>Ś. 7. 13</ls>. .²2 To bless, wish well to; एवं ते देवा आशंसन्तु <ls>Mk. 1</ls>; इत्याशशंसे करणैरबाह्यैः <ls>R. 14. 50</ls>. .²3 To speak, say. .²4 To tell; आशंसता बाणगतिं वृषाङ्के <ls>Ku. 3. 14</ls>. .²5 To ask for, beg. .²6 To praise. .²7 To repeat, recite. .²8 To fear, be afraid of. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To render famous or celebrated.
